events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of humour has kept us laughing for decades.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost him. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, and he would have been 80. The showman lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. Pure genius.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since we lost him. His music and message continue to resonate globally. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, known for his innovative artistry and chameleon-like personas, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman today, as David Bowie would have turned 80. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music and legacy continue to captivate generations. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's most influential guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod The Mod 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades and a voice instantly recognisable. Still rockin'.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! Here's to more 'One Step Beyond' moments.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! The voice behind 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away'. An 80s legend.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent and heart shine as brightly as her rhinestones. What's your favourite Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s R&B and soul hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate his fantastic career.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction ceremony 38 years ago
events.blurb: The inaugural induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, cementing the legacies of rock's founding fathers. A truly historic moment!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming us with his distinctive voice and style.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert 58 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The final public performance of the Fab Four – what a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo stardom, his drumming and vocals are unmistakable.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo superstar, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: TV Legend 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, he's given us some of the most iconic characters in British TV history. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens & The Big Bopper 68 years ago
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', a tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three legends: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. 'The Day The Music Died' remains a poignant moment in music history. Their legacy lives on.
